title: Solar Decathlon: PitchedHouse
text: PitchedHouse was developed by the CCMH Team, a collaboration among Chongqing University, CSCEC Southwest Architectural Design and Research Institute, Midea Group, and HYP-ARCH. The project successfully completed the 48-hour zero-energy operation challenge at the third Solar Decathlon China and received the Most Innovative Smart Connectivity Award.

title: Design Studio 1: ZaoHouse
text: ZaoHouse explores the design, fabrication, and on-site assembly of prefabricated housing. Developed as part of a collaborative design-build studio, the project investigates three approaches to creating affordable, sustainable, and adaptable residential prototypes that can be assembled within one week.
note: Tsinghua University · Shenzhen-Hong Kong Bi-City Biennale of Urbanism/Architecture (2023)

title: Design Studio 2: Horizon
text: Horizon envisions a human settlement on Mars inspired by the concept of a Martian kibbutz, emphasizing collective living and shared resources. The design translates relationships between public and private spaces into computational algorithms, integrating community planning, residential clusters, and modular habitat units into an adaptive settlement system. Emerging intelligent construction technologies and computational design methods enable the development of livable, interconnected neighborhoods in the Martian environment.
note: Tsinghua University · Graduate Design Studio II, Spring 2023
